entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.825257 solar radii from Lafarga et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TIC 18942729 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.548ag512L/abstract). Mass 0.652 +/- 0.078 solar masses from Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the mass of TIC 18942729 (VizieR IV/39/tic82); no NASA Exoplanet Archive row gives one, nor does Gaia DR3 FLAME (https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-3881/ab3467). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,360.11 K and log g 4.42 (u1 0.790, u2 0.008): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
